info.title: Black Box Admin API
info.description: Control plane for accounts, users, invitations, service and agent identities, PKI, proxy, API tokens, logs, and store metrics. Authenticated requests use a NATS user JWT as a Bearer token together with the X-Blackbox-AccountID header carrying the account public key that issued the token. Error bodies are JSON-shaped but served as text/plain. The AI assistant lives under /api/v1/ai and the same tool set is served to MCP clients at /mcp.

bearerAuth.description: NATS user JWT from /api/v1/login; send with X-Blackbox-AccountID.

AccountID.name: X-Blackbox-AccountID
AccountID.description: Account public key (user.account_id from login). Required on bearer-authenticated calls; the JWT is validated against it.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size, 1 to 200. Naming limit or offset turns the response into a page object (see Page) instead of the complete array; totals describe the entire collection.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based row offset. Follow next_offset while has_more is true. Live data may change between requests.

Error.description: Error bodies are JSON-shaped text but are served with Content-Type text/plain; parse defensively.

Page.description: A page of a list route, answered when the request names limit or offset. items holds this page in the route's documented order; total counts the whole collection.

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page; absent on the last page.

token.description: Original issue-time NATS JWT; do not use for API auth

id.description: NATS account public nkey; same as public_key

roles.description: Application roles granted to the agent so its JWT passes the same role gates a user with those roles would. None by default. On re-registration of an existing host, naming roles or permissions updates the agent and reissues its token.

token.description: Freshly minted NATS user JWT; use as the Bearer token

OAuthNewUserResponse.description: Returned by the OAuth callback when the Google identity has no account yet; follow with POST /api/v1/oauth/accounts.

hostname.description: OS hostname of the publishing node; absent from entries stored before it was recorded

fields.description: Structured fields from the log call site

LogBucket.description: One group of a log summary.

NATSPermissions.description: NATS subject permissions written into the identity's JWT. Omitted or empty means unrestricted. Once a publish allow list is set, everything not listed is denied, so include the baseline subjects every agent or service needs: _INBOX.>, $SRV.>, sys.log.>, sys.metrics.>. API calls over NATS publish to api.{service}.{METHOD}.>.

AIUsage.description: Token counts: cumulative on a session, per turn on a usage event.

input.description: The tool input as the model produced it

content.description: What the model read; truncated to 2000 bytes in transcripts

denied.description: The approval policy refused the call; result carries the message the model was given

AIMessage.description: One entry of a session's history. content is the provider's native content blocks and is never edited; the other fields are a display projection.

text.description: The user's prompt or the assistant's visible text

credential.description: Vault name of the model credential
Vault name of the ai_model token to use; empty picks the first visible one

AIEvent.description: The data of one SSE frame on the message route. Only the fields relevant to type are set: text for text, thinking, and compaction; call for tool_use; result for tool_result; usage for usage; stop_reason for done (end_turn, max_tokens, refusal, max_turns, or provider-specific); error for error.

AICredentialRef.description: A vault credential without its secret.

enabled.description: A model credential is visible to the caller

metadata.description: Stored on every chunk; source_id and chunk are reserved

id.description: Stored document id ({source}#{n} for a chunk)

AIUsageRecord.description: One AI run as an instance stored and reported it. id is a ULID.

credential.description: Vault name of the model credential, never its secret.

source_account.description: NATS account the record arrived from, set by the collector.

AIInstanceSummary.description: One running AI instance as the collector last saw it.

post.description: Model Context Protocol server offering the same tool set the in-process assistant sees: one tool per admin API operation (prefix admin_), the generic admin_api_request tool, memory, and, with an embedding credential, search_documents, remember, and recall. Every tool call runs through the admin API with the caller's own bearer, so REST permissions apply unchanged. Stateless: each POST is one JSON-RPC exchange; GET and DELETE answer 405. Clients send the user's JWT as the bearer and the account as the accountID query parameter (for example /mcp?accountID=...), since MCP clients cannot set X-Blackbox-AccountID.

parameters.name: accountID
parameters.description: Account public key the bearer was issued by

200.description: JSON-RPC response, as application/json or text/event-stream

post.description: Checks a model, embedding, or MCP server credential against its provider without running the assistant. A model credential reads its model from the provider (no tokens are spent), an embedding credential embeds one short string, and an MCP server is connected and its tools listed. The name resolves like every other use: the caller's own credential first, then the account's. A failed test answers 200 with ok false and error_kind; the message never contains the secret.

name.description: The credential's name in the vault.

200.description: The test ran; ok says whether the credential works.

400.description: Missing name or unknown kind.

404.description: No credential of that kind and name is visible to the caller.
